_doc: MECHANISM PROOF (combined stack). Single saturating rung (64 pods) at 200k and 500k on the fixed 4-vCPU server, --wal-stats 5 so the server emits per-interval WAL_CONT contention counters. Goal: show combined keeps inner_wait_load / dirty_wait_load ~0 and waiters_woken_avg flat across 200k->500k, i.e. cardinality no longer drives contention. Image = durable-streams:combined (perf/combined-t1a-t1c-t2a @ f04baa64e; --worker-threads 4 pins the pool to the 4-vCPU cgroup). Paired with run-durable-cpu4-stats-base.
